title: test: add five Selenium patient journeys
head: feature/selenium-tests

reviews.body:
### Task 9 assisted self-review

Reviewed the current PR head's Maven profile, all four Selenium classes, fictional fixture, test plan, guide and evidence. This is a single-owner COMMENT self-review assisted by Codex; no independent approval is claimed.

- All five journeys assert meaningful user outcomes; booking and cancellation also check availability changes, status persists after reauthentication, and fixture cancellation is asserted during teardown.
- Explicit waits and stable scoped locators replace fixed sleeps. Accounts are unique, each browser is fresh, and `quit` runs in `finally`.
- The failure extension captures before cleanup and rethrows the original error. An actual isolated intentional failure returned Maven exit 1 and wrote the preserved screenshot.
- Initial Maven verification passed 34 backend and five browser tests; the focused repeat passed five again. Normal Failsafe includes only PortalSeleniumIT; the probe requires explicit test/flag selection.
- Selenium is test scoped and opt-in; application source, Jenkinsfile and deployment scripts are unchanged. The final POM metadata correction was verified by successful report-only generation.
- Saved HTML/AX/screenshot shows five cases, zero failures/errors/skips and 100%. Initial checkpoint screenshots retain matching initial metadata, while HTML reports the focused rerun. Execution dates come from logs, not the inherited report header.
- Jenkins browser integration/deployment gating remains Task 10, with Docker/Ansible tasks pending.

No blocking issue found for the Task 9 scope.
reviews.author: kirti-vispute
